original_ai_output.title_zh: 奥贡州居民担忧因向中国投资者分配土地而遭驱逐
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥贡州Obafemi Owode地方政府区Orile-Mo的Fere和Oniporogun社区居民呼吁州长Dapo Abiodun介入，据称当地将土地分配给中国投资者，居民担心此举将导致数百家庭无家可归并破坏祖传遗产。居民称推土机和安保人员已被部署到争议地块开始作业，并呼吁在周六举行抗议。目前该消息为单一来源报道，相关指控尚未获得独立证实。

location.site: Fere and Oniporogun communities, Obafemi Owode LGA
location.raw_text: Fere and Oniporogun communities in Orile-Mo, Obafemi Owode Local Government Area of Ogun State

key_facts.fact: 奥贡州居民呼吁州长介入据称向中国投资者分配土地一事
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Residents of Fere and Oniporogun communities in Orile-Mo, Obafemi Owode Local Government Area of Ogun State, have appealed to Governor Dapo Abiodun to intervene in an alleged land allocation to Chinese investors

key_facts.fact: 居民警告该举措可能使数百家庭无家可归并破坏祖传遗产
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: warning that the move could render hundreds of families homeless and destroy their ancestral heritage

key_facts.fact: 居民称推土机和安保人员已被部署到争议地块开始作业
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: alleging that bulldozers and security personnel had been deployed to commence operations on land where homes and other properties had already been developed

key_facts.fact: 居民呼吁周六在争议地点举行抗议
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The residents appealed for a protest on Saturday at the disputed site

key_facts.fact: Fere社区首领称居民自2017年起就村庄扩建问题与政府交涉但未解决
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Baale of Fere community, Chief Okesola Alani, said residents had been engaging the government since 2017 over the need for an extension of the village, lamenting that the matter remained unresolved

uncertainties: 土地分配及推土机、安保人员部署情况为居民指控，尚未获得独立证实
事件目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，缺乏交叉验证
抗议是否实际举行尚不明确
